summary_1line: Armies assemble for Kurukshetra; omens appear, Bhishma exhorts Kshatriyas to embrace warrior death, and commanders with distinctive standards take their battle positions.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma in white armor and umbrella stands on a silver chariot with a golden palmyra banner, shining like the moon amid the vast army.
The two colossal armies facing each other across the plain resemble two oceans filled with crocodiles and sea‑monsters at the end of an age.
As the sun rises split in two and blazing, jackals and crows cry over the battlefield while banners and weapons glitter across the ranks.
